correctness.rationale: The sixteen-bit-free exact enumeration over 18 graph-edge bits has 1010 matchings including empty, f-vector (18,117,332,390,144,8), and augmented F2 boundary ranks (1,17,100,232,136,8). Rank-over-Q is at least rank mod 2 and Euler is -22, proving rational homology only in degree 3 of rank 22. For all 24 vertex-label permutations, two independently implemented formulas (signed simplex traces, compatible orbit independence evaluation) agree; class trace (22,0,2,-2,-2) and the exact S4 character inner products yield multiplicities (0,1,3,2,3). Natural transfer yields quotient invariant ranks 0 and 1 for S4 and A4. The verifier is standalone and has been executed from its actual path; integral claims and other groups are not asserted.

value.rationale: The matching complex of a canonical Archimedean solid is a motivated finite topological invariant, with an independently known but symmetry-blind 22-sphere homotopy type. The complete 24-element character splits into four distinct nontrivial Specht types with nontrivial multiplicities and establishes a structural distinction: rotational tetrahedral symmetry preserves one rational degree-3 class whereas full tetrahedral symmetry preserves none. These facts cannot be inferred from the existing Betti number or sphere-wedge theorem, and the exact quotient cohomology is a natural further use.
